title: Q&A with Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince on bot traffic potentially reaching 1000x human traffic, reviving HTTP 402 to charge bots, blocking Google, and more (Nilay Patel/The Verge)
summary: Nilay Patel / The Verge: Q&A with Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince on bot traffic potentially reaching 1000x human traffic, reviving HTTP 402 to charge bots, blocking Google, and more — Cloudflare's mission to remake the business of the web for the AI age — Today, I'm talking with Matthew Prince, who is CEO of Cloudflare.
